analyst.summary: EIH Ltd, the flagship of the Oberoi Group, operates India's most iconic luxury hotel brands (Oberoi and Trident) along with cruise and catering businesses. The company has an excellent, nearly debt-free balance sheet and healthy operating margins, but its most recent full year saw profit decline even as revenue grew modestly -- a gap that available disclosures do not fully explain and that is worth watching into upcoming quarters. The stock has underperformed for the past one to two years. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely high-quality luxury brand and balance sheet, but near-term profit momentum has softened in a way that isn't yet fully explained.
